population: Late-training replay of the completed static-control and static+B learners, seeds 1511/1522/1533. Not final-policy on-policy observations, not historical full-trained policy replay, and not sealed-test data.
interpretation: Purely offline descriptive feature content. Correlated transition/agent/direction samples do not establish prediction accuracy, feature use by learned networks, a causal explanation for old full-vs-static results, treatment efficacy, safety or novelty.
difference_arithmetic: Float32 subtraction of float32 provider outputs; float64 population moments; exact quantiles of retained float32 values.

provider_trace.source_scope: Trace recomputes frozen provider equations inside this audit, and is cross-checked against the unmodified provider outputs. Source ties are nonexclusive; counts need not sum to the denominator.
provider_trace.identity_scope: Entity IDs are typed observation-slot indices only. Persistent/world entity IDs are not encoded in these inputs and remain unknown. Boundary slots 0..2 are lower x/y/z faces, 3..5 upper x/y/z faces.
provider_trace.sentinel_scope: Nearest-valid geometric minimum is measured before invalid-slot fill. The provider minimum also includes invalid-slot sentinel clearance=40m, or static-mode disabled-family neutral=40m. Valid far objects and a strictly smaller sentinel can coexist; neither means raw-object absence.
provider_trace.first_hit_scope: Attribution uses families tied for minimum at the first sampled hit; nonpositive families at that same time are also counted separately. No-hit probes have no first-hit source.
provider_trace.derived_scope: TTC uses first sampled hit, reserve uses current minimum and ego braking, positive flag uses preview minimum; braking distance itself is ego-only. Attribution is descriptive and is not a causal learning claim.
